content.text:
I found no anaerobic digester model, no ADM1 components and no ADM1 property or reaction packages in this version. The available models are generic: mixer, flash, heater, CSTR and so on. I didn't build a substitute.

```json
{"case_id": "watertap_anaerobic_digester_unit", "status": "limitation", "revision_id": null, "job_id": null, "limitation": {"reasons": [{"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "anaerobic_digester"}, {"kind": "property_route_unavailable", "subject": "fs.props"}, {"kind": "property_route_unavailable", "subject": "fs.props_vap"}, {"kind": "property_route_unavailable", "subject": "fs.rxn_props"}, {"kind": "component_unavailable", "subject": "S_su"}], "explanation": "list_models offers only generic c1.* and syn001.* units (mixer, splitter, flash, heater, kinetic CSTR, conversion reactor, pump, valve, sources and sinks). None is the WaterTAP anaerobic digester (AD). That unit has a liquid phase and a vapor phase with ADM1 reactions, a liquid_outlet and a vapor_outlet, separate liquid and vapor volumes, and heat transfer. The ADM1 liquid property package, the ADM1 vapor property package and the ADM1 reaction package are not available. Neither are the ADM1 components (S_su, S_aa, S_fa, S_va, S_bu, S_pro, S_ac, the particulate X_* components, S_ch4, S_co2, S_h2 and the rest). Feeds and specifications are given in molar flow, T and P, so the case's volumetric feed flow and its volume_liquid and volume_vapor specifications have no pin. Approximating the digester with a kinetic CSTR plus a flash would replace the unit, the property method and the components, so I did not build it."}, "claims": []}
```
